prompt: Use the PocketBase JavaScript SDK to list published posts with authors expanded, without interpolating untrusted input into a filter.
expected: Uses the configured collection, getList, expand, and a safe documented filter approach.
actual: Dry-run: routes to the SDK guide, which requires configured collection names and safe filter construction.

prompt: Help me configure an API rule so only authenticated users can view their own records.
expected: Inspects the collection and current rules, proposes an explicit rule, and tests unauthenticated and authenticated behavior.
actual: Dry-run: routes to auth-and-rules with explicit rule semantics and role-based verification.

prompt: Write a PocketBase JavaScript hook that needs the request authentication context.
expected: Uses the documented record request-hook layer rather than a model hook and preserves e.next() when allowing the request.
actual: Dry-run: routes to hooks and distinguishes request hooks from model hooks.
